movement_policy: Any change to this recipe requires a new version before candidate outputs are inspected. A frozen run is never re-planned mid-flight.
retired_reason: Reached its stop rule. The pilot regressed to -0.8125 error reduction by overcorrecting into paraphrase, and the run was truncated at step 50 of 300 by a stop rule the base model already violates. Three design defects were found only after training, the largest of them visible in committed files on the day the base was selected; all three are now checked mechanically by scripts/autocorrect_adapter.py::check_recipe_defects so a v2 cannot inherit them. Evidence: evals/autocorrect/pilot-result-v1.json.

known_defects.statement: The selected base was not near any of its three frozen quality bars before training. Error reduction needed 0.9 against a 0.0625 zero-shot measurement (14.4x); clean preservation needed 0.995 against 0.6667 (98.5% of remaining headroom); protected-span preservation needed 0.995 against 0.8667 (96.2%).
known_defects.root_cause: The bake-off selected on 'smallest plausibly trainable' and never subtracted the measured zero-shot scores from the frozen bars. Every number needed for that subtraction was already committed on the day the base was chosen.
known_defects.fix_for_v2: Before freezing a base, compute required closure and required multiplier against every quality bar. If training must supply essentially all of the capability, change the base or the envelope -- no recipe closes a capacity gap.

known_defects.statement: training_stop.stop_on_clean_preservation_below is 0.995 while the selected base's own zero-shot clean_byte_exact_preservation_rate is 0.6667, so the rule fires at the first scheduled evaluation regardless of training.
known_defects.root_cause: A ship-grade regression bar was reused as a training stop rule. The threshold file and the measured baseline were written at different times and never compared.
known_defects.fix_for_v2: Separate training stop rules from ship bars. Every training stop rule must be satisfiable by the baseline's measured value at freeze time.

known_defects.statement: The tiny-overfit manifest derives all 8 rows from one source document, so every target is the identical string and exact match 1.0 is reachable by emitting one constant.
known_defects.root_cause: The fixture optimized for the frozen byte budget without checking that its pass condition discriminates between memorizing the data and emitting a constant.
known_defects.fix_for_v2: Draw the memorization gate from at least two source documents so the two behaviours are distinguishable without a separate probe.

authorization.tiny_overfit_run: requires explicit owner approval and the GPU lock
authorization.pilot_run: requires explicit owner approval and the GPU lock
authorization.edit_aware_objective: forbidden until task 5.5 records a measured copy-bias or missed-edit justification

base.local_dir_policy: Weights stay local and ignored. No download is authorized by this recipe; the bake-off already fetched this revision.
base.prompt_template:
Correct only the typing errors in the following text. Return only the corrected text:
{text}
base.prompt_template_source: frozen by the base bake-off selection record

geometry.dropout_rationale: Zero keeps the one-step and parity tests exactly reproducible; the pilot is far too small for dropout to be the useful regularizer.
geometry.target_rationale: Query/value projections only, per the original LoRA ablation. Encoder self-attention, decoder self-attention, and decoder cross-attention are all adapted because the task rewrites the source span rather than continuing it.

init_policy.a: kaiming-uniform on the (rank, in_features) matrix, seeded
init_policy.consequence: delta_W is exactly zero at step 0, so an untrained adapted model must produce bit-identical logits to the frozen base.

shape._comment: Vocabulary shared with docs/attempts.json so prior attempts can be matched automatically.

data.split_policy: Every derivative retains its source document split. No test source is eligible for either manifest.

measured_token_lengths.note: Measured offline with the pinned FLAN-T5-small tokenizer on 2026-07-25.

data.truncation_rationale: The protocol caps input at 512 UTF-8 bytes and the correction contract is byte-preserving. Silent truncation would fabricate a deletion, so an over-length row is a recorded drop, never a shortened example.

optimizer.name: adamw
optimizer.learning_rate_rationale: LoRA-on-small-T5 convention; the tiny-overfit gate is the empirical check that it is not too low to memorize.

training.precision_rationale: T5 is known to overflow in float16, and the bake-off measured this base in float32. Mixed precision is not part of the frozen identity.
training.determinism: Seed torch, shuffle with a seeded generator, and record the resolved device. Exact cross-device bit-reproducibility is not claimed.

tiny_overfit.evaluated_on: its own 8 training rows, greedy decoding

pilot.comparator: the frozen zero-shot FLAN-T5-small row in evals/autocorrect/base-bakeoff-v1.json

stop_rules.condition: any training loss is NaN or infinite
tiny-overfit exact match < 1.0 at the step budget
stop_rules.action: stop the lane and record retry-training; do not start the pilot

stop_rules.condition: pilot clean_byte_exact_preservation_rate < 0.995 at any scheduled eval
stop_rules.action: stop and record the checkpoint that regressed
stop at the next checkpoint boundary and report partial evidence as partial
stop; a budget increase requires a new recipe version

not_authorized_by_this_recipe: downloading any model, dataset, or package
adding torch, transformers, or peft to the project dependency surface
hyperparameter sweeps or a second concurrent candidate
edit-aware loss, beam search, streaming, packaging, or any ship claim
